raw.rationale: The compound is a launched alpha-2 adrenergic agonist (ADRA2A) used for opioid withdrawal, with no known broad cytotoxic or lineage-selective anticancer mechanism at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-concentration screens of such non-oncology drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing beyond base rates. Therefore probabilities are set near the low end of the stated 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation for lineage-specific ADRA2A expression or transporter effects.
